paragraphs.text:

# HORN-Z1 — Chinese Room

This notebook executes the canonical `maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json` artifact. HORN owns meaning and authored geometry; Zeppelin owns interaction and execution. The mural is primary. The network view is a lossy semantic/debug projection and cannot rewrite the HORN document.

paragraphs.title: Manifest
paragraphs.text:
%sh
set -eu
cd "${HORN_REPO:-.}"
npm run --silent horn-zeppelin -- manifest maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json

paragraphs.title: Validate
paragraphs.text:
%sh
set -eu
cd "${HORN_REPO:-.}"
npm run --silent horn-zeppelin -- validate maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json

paragraphs.title: Mural
paragraphs.text:
%sh
set -eu
cd "${HORN_REPO:-.}"
npm run --silent horn-zeppelin -- render maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json

paragraphs.text:
%sh

set -eu
cd "${HORN_REPO:-.}"
npm run --silent horn-zeppelin -- audit maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json

paragraphs.title: Notes
paragraphs.text:
%md
## Authority boundary

The network paragraph is not a map serialization. It omits authored node/region geometry, relation routes and label geometry, mural styling, and the full spatial semantics of the reading path. Use the manifest digest to bind every notebook result back to the exact HORN input bytes.
